role: Section Officer — the party's immediate superior
description: Runs Section Nine, which means he runs the party's day. Middling rank, total authority over everything they do between reveille and lights out, and none whatsoever over anything that matters. He hazes new intakes because he was hazed, believes it builds character, and has never once examined the belief. Not cruel and not stupid — a small man with a clipboard, protecting the only thing he has, which is being the person who decides what six teenagers do next.
designNotes: Created 2026-09-13 at Ingram's suggestion: 'we need to put someone in charge of the PC group, someone who isn't a great or nice person, an antagonist from within the system who the players will eventually defeat by proving them wrong, out performing their expectations and eventually they'll be promoted out of that petty tyrants clutches.' He sends the party for a bubble in Session One's The Errand, which is the scene that introduces Manako. Full writeup, arc and voice: ideas/story/bible/characters/the-section-officer.md. Name deliberately open.
